simulation_brief.primary_question: Will Player C win the 2026 Australian Open men's singles title?
simulation_brief.resolution_rule: yes only if Player C wins the men's singles title by tournament end
simulation_brief.summary: Forecast scenario about whether Player C wins the 2026 Australian Open men's singles title. Player C is top seed, still alive in late rounds, with strong form and career-motivation, but faces draw-path uncertainty, fatigue sensitivity, and at least one elite-opponent threat including an all-time great with strong Melbourne history and a recent champion-caliber rival.
uncertainty_notes: Exact round position is not explicitly fixed beyond 'alive deep in the tournament'.
Specific identities of Player C and rival players are masked and should remain fictionalized.
Outcome is unresolved at T0; reaching the final is explicitly not sufficient.
